ModulePrefs.title: rate_of_catalyst_reaction
ModulePrefs.author: rytan451; lookang
ModulePrefs.description:
This simulation illustrates the collision theory and shows how it can be used to explain rates of reaction. Amount of Catalyst, Surface Area of Catalyst, Temperature and Amount of Reactants (Reactant 1) may all be adjusted before running the simulation to see how your changes affect the rate of reaction.
Reactant 1: Blue Product: Green
